title: Tarlton Springs
blurb: A rejected take-off above V1 and a runway overrun at an unlit regional aerodrome, worked from the first notification through to the Evidence and Argument Tables and the final investigation report.
cardLine: A regional turboprop rejects its take-off above V1 at night as two kangaroos cross the runway, strikes them and leaves the end of the runway.
photoAlt: A white regional turboprop airliner parked on an airport apron at sunset
